title: Tofu Bhurji
description: High-protein Indian-style tofu scramble with cumin and curry leaves.
ingredients: ½–¾ tsp oil (use 2½ tsp for ~75 extra kcal)
250 g Lidl plain tofu, grated (or 1 × 280 g Tesco Tofoo Naked pack)
Coriander, chopped, to top (optional; omitted from estimates)

costNotes.GBP: Lidl: half a £2.49/500 g pack. Tesco whole-pack recipe: £3.66 to £3.96.

nutritionNote: Lidl tofu; protein and calories vary by brand.
